punchline: Ray Kroc told a room of MBA students that his business was not hamburgers. It was real estate.
thirty_sec: In Kiyosaki's retelling, McDonald's founder Ray Kroc gives a talk to an MBA class in Texas, then goes out for beers with the students. He asks them what business he is in. Hamburgers, they say. Real estate, he answers. Kiyosaki's point is that the hamburger sold the restaurant, and the land under it was what the company was really building. His advice: mind your own business, meaning the assets you build beside your job.
